4.name: Targon
4.hardware_requirements: 24GB+ VRAM recommended. RTX 3090/4090 or A100. CUDA 12+.
4.readme_summary: Targon is a deterministic verification subnet. Miners run inference on vLLM-compatible models. Validators verify outputs deterministically.

19.name: Blockmachine
19.hardware_requirements: 8GB+ VRAM minimum. 24GB recommended for competitive scoring.
19.readme_summary: Blockmachine subnet for decentralized ML inference and text generation tasks.

39.name: Cathedral/Basilica
39.hardware_requirements: Was GPU compute rental. Now deprecated with zero emission.
39.readme_summary: SN39 was Cathedral/Basilica GPU compute rental subnet. Deprecated. Zero emission.

44.name: Score Vision
44.hardware_requirements: 8GB+ VRAM minimum. 24GB recommended. GPU required for vision inference.
44.readme_summary: Score Vision subnet for sports prediction and computer vision tasks. Miners run vision models to predict sports outcomes.

50.name: Synth
50.hardware_requirements: 8GB+ VRAM. Runs synthetic data generation workloads.
50.readme_summary: Synth subnet for synthetic data generation and augmentation. Miners generate high-quality synthetic training data.

54.name: Yanez MIID
54.hardware_requirements: 8GB+ VRAM minimum. 24GB recommended for KAV/UAV workloads.
54.readme_summary: MIID Identity subnet. Miners generate synthetic identity data including KAV (Known Attack Vectors) and UAV (Unknown Attack Vectors) for compliance training.

64.name: Chutes
64.hardware_requirements: Any GPU. A100 SXM preferred for competitive scoring. 3090/4090 viable.
64.readme_summary: Chutes is a serverless GPU compute marketplace on Bittensor. Miners contribute GPU compute, validators route workloads. Egret chutes on A100 hardware earn best.

95.name: Actual
95.readme_summary: Actual Finance subnet. Repo URL unconfirmed — verify before mining.

97.name: Albedo
97.readme_summary: Albedo remote sensing subnet. Repo URL unconfirmed — verify before mining.

105.name: Beam
105.hardware_requirements: No GPU required for orchestrator. Workers need GPU based on workload type.
105.readme_summary: Beam is Bittensor's streaming compute subnet. Orchestrators route jobs to workers. Workers execute GPU workloads. Requires WebSocket server to earn emissions.

40.name: chunk
40.hardware_requirements: No GPU required. CPU-only miners viable. RAG chunking workload — text processing only.
40.readme_summary: Chunk subnet for RAG document chunking and text segmentation. Miners process documents into optimized chunks for retrieval. CPU mining competitive.

116.name: hard_sign
116.readme_summary: hard_sign subnet. Official repo not yet confirmed. Check TaoStats or Discord before registering.

57.name: gaia
57.hardware_requirements: 8GB+ VRAM minimum. Runs LLM inference via GaiaNet nodes.
57.readme_summary: Gaia subnet for decentralized LLM inference. Miners run GaiaNet nodes serving AI queries.
